title: AutoCAD Plant 3D workflows and connector status
description: Explore AutoCAD Plant 3D workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

AutoCAD Plant 3D

AutoCAD Plant 3D supports process-plant modelling, piping specifications and isometric documentation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Lay out process equipment

Use the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended AutoCAD Plant 3D preview, lay out process equipment; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Route specification-driven piping

Start from the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended AutoCAD Plant 3D preview, route specification-driven piping; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Produce isometrics and reports

Begin with the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended AutoCAD Plant 3D preview, produce isometrics and reports; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
